task: Independent ViFailback source labels, measured modalities and visual feasibility verification

pilot_policy.matching: same original task directory; nearest frame length; tie by source episode index
pilot_policy.frame_policy: 16 uniformly spaced frame positions including first and last, floor(k*(N-1)/15) for k=0..15
pilot_policy.camera_policy: same 16 indices in all three views
pilot_policy.crop_policy: same fixed normalized center ROI per camera and class; supplementary to full view
pilot_policy.label_use: outcomes/categories used only to balance pilot case selection, never select frames/crops/offsets

source_scope: 20 matched executions; two complete original HDF5 validation samples; two additional quality-control tables/high videos; bounded original QC HDF5 ranges; secondary archive prefixes only
cohort_status: Only selected actual samples validated; 5023-row metadata QC cohort is provisional, not fully acquired/validated
duplicate_policy: Preserve raw sources; future representative/group policy to be frozen before training
